s.headline: VALORANT 13.09: New Agent Hush, Warden Buffs, Bug Fixes
top_changes: New Agent Hush added with telekinesis abilities
Warden weapon recoil and spread improvements
Clove movement speed and kill reward adjustments
Haste and Snapshot buff terms standardized
Ability tooltips redesigned with passives added
buffs: Warden: pitch recoil smoothed for first bullets
Haste: new official term for movement speed buff
Snapshot: new official term for silhouette reveal
Brimstone: Stim Beacon shows Haste buff
Neon: High Gear/Overdrive shows Haste buff
nerfs: Clove: Pick-me-up bonus movement speed 15% to 10%
Clove: Not Dead Yet kill grants ult and signature point
s.meta_impact: Hush's introduction will reshape early agent picks with her unique displacement and suspension tools. Warden gains viability at 2900 credits due to handling buffs. Clove standardization reduces her outlier movement advantage.

s.headline: E-District Night Removed, Day Version Rotated In
top_changes: E-District (night) removed from all map rotations
E-District (day) added to map rotations
Improved E-District (night) planned for end of month
Future night version to have reduced fog density and adjusted colors
s.meta_impact: Switch to E-District day improves visibility and reduces fog issues for clearer fights. Aggressive strategies may become more viable with better sightlines. Meta remains stable until improved night version returns later this split.

breakdown.name: E-District
breakdown.change: Night version removed from rotations; day version added instead

s.headline: LoL 26.22: Corki/Rumble buffs, Locke/Yasuo nerfs, Mel midscope
top_changes: Corki and Rumble R buffs for pro play
Locke and Yasuo nerfs to early power
Mel midscope moves power to scaling
Doran's Bow nerfed for ADC builds
ARAM augment balance and map returns
buffs: Aurelion Sol: Singularity damage and AP ratio increased
Corki: Missile Barrage and Big One damage up
Kayle: Q and R cooldowns reduced
Naafiri: Q heal and W AD increased
Shen: Q monster damage modifier up
nerfs: Locke: Q stack damage and W duration reduced
Thresh: Base AD and R damage lowered
Yasuo: Q total AD ratio reduced
Doran's Bow: Attack Damage reduced to 7
s.meta_impact: Corki and Rumble gain viability outside pro play while Locke and Yasuo see reduced early dominance. Mel's changes shift her toward late-game scaling with reworked W. Doran's Bow nerf encourages more varied ADC itemization on Rift.
